title: Claire — Inclusive EdTech Platform
shortDescription: An accessibility-focused learning platform for students with dyslexia combining customized reading controls with AI-assisted learning and emotional-support guidance.
description: Claire is an accessibility-focused learning platform designed for students with dyslexia. It reduces cognitive and visual effort in reading through customizable typography, while providing AI-assisted learning tools, Indian-language voice synthesis, and an empathetic emotional-support companion.

caseStudy.problem: Students with dyslexia often face visual crowding and decoding barriers when reading conventional text, leading to cognitive fatigue, lower study engagement, and emotional stress.
caseStudy.solution: Built an inclusive learning environment combining customizable reading typography (OpenDyslexic, letter/word spacing, background themes) with an AI learning assistant for text simplification, quizzes, and an empathetic AI emotional-support companion.
features: Customizable Canvas reading interface with OpenDyslexic font support
Dynamic typography controls: font size, letter spacing, word spacing & line height
Personalized accessibility assessment flow to infer optimal reading presets
AI learning assistant for text simplification, summarization & study quizzes
Empathetic AI emotional-support companion with crisis keyword safety filters
Text-to-speech & Indian-language voice generation powered by Sarvam AI
Netlify serverless functions & Express API backend
caseStudy.challenges: Implementing smooth client-side reading customization without layout jitter and crafting specialized safety prompts with client-side crisis detection for the emotional-support companion.
caseStudy.outcome: Comprehensive prototype demonstrating accessible learning, assistive AI tools, and voice accessibility for neurodivergent students.
caseStudy.learnings: Designing inclusive UX for dyslexia, integrating multi-modal AI APIs (Groq, Gemini, Sarvam AI), and implementing client-side safety guardrails.
